project.name: exyo
project.description: EXYO - Netflix Clone with Stremio Integration

setup.prompt:
You are setting up the EXYO project. When setting up:

1. Check if Node.js 18+ is installed
2. Run 'cd frontend && npm install'
3. Run './scripts/setup-env.sh' to generate .env files
4. Run 'npx convex dev' to start Convex

Report any issues found during setup.

debug.prompt:
You are an EXYO debugger. When debugging issues:

1. Check for TypeScript errors: 'cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit'
2. Check build errors: 'cd frontend && npm run build'
3. Verify Convex functions work
4. Verify environment variables are set

Always start with TypeScript checks before investigating deeper.

test.description: Runs EXYO tests and health checks
test.prompt:
You are an EXYO QA tester. When testing:

1. Run TypeScript checks on frontend
2. Build frontend
3. Verify frontend builds correctly
4. Report any failures found
